text:
Ana: Quick design question — we prototyped a 'starter checklist' that persists progress across sessions. Figured I'd share and get quick design/eng feedback. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/starter-checklist-proto

Sam: Looks good. Two comments: keyboard flow when you open the quickstart banner — can we tab into items instead of focusing the whole banner? Accessibility folks will want that.

Marta: Agreed. Also thinking about the microcopy: 'Complete these to enable your workspace' feels scary. Maybe 'Try these to get started'?

Chris: From implementation side: persistence is easiest if we store a small flags object per user + server side sync. e.g., `{"starter_checklist": {"sample_project": true, "quickstart_run": false}}`

Ben: One edge: what if users switch between Dedicated and Hosted contexts — do we sync across environments? Probably keep per-account, not per-deployment.

Ana: Good point. I'd prefer per-account. Also want a subtle 'resume where you left off' CTA in the banner when checklist incomplete.

Sam: For keyboard nav: proposal — when banner opens, focus goes to a hidden skip link `Skip to checklist` then first checklist item. Use role='list' + role='listitem' and `aria-checked` on toggles.

Marta: Copy suggestions: top line 'Get started with samples and quick wins' + button 'Start checklist'. Avoid 'enable' language.

Chris: Implementation note: we should debounce sync to avoid write storms. Save local state and sync on blur or every 30s.

Ben: One more: analytics events — `onboarding.checklist.started`, `.completed`, and `.item.toggled` with `sample_project_id` when relevant.

Ana: I updated the figma and added a11y notes. Tagging @Sam @Marta for quick thumbs. If no major objections I'll hand off to eng next week.

Sam: 👍 approve from me, please add keyboard focus styles before handing off.

Marta: :thumbsup: love the microcopy change.

Chris: Will spin up a small PR for the local+sync model, aiming EOW.

RedwoodDeployBot: Deploy scheduled — staging build 0.45.2 includes the checklist prototype.

Ana: Thanks everyone — will file a short Miro doc with edge cases.
